UseMVC.description: Render blocks in-process with the site's own Razor partial views instead of posting them to a headless frontend. Host, Api and ApiKey are ignored when true.

Host.description: The base URL for block preview requests. Ignored when UseMVC is true.

Api.description: Relative path to the API endpoint that returns preview HTML. Ignored when UseMVC is true.

ApiKey.description: API key sent in the kuhb-header request header. Ignored when UseMVC is true.

TimeoutSeconds.description: Seconds to wait for the frontend before the preview fails. Ignored when UseMVC is true.

BlockGridViewsPath.description: Folder holding the Block Grid component partial views ({alias}.cshtml). Only used when UseMVC is true.

BlockListViewsPath.description: Folder holding the Block List component partial views ({alias}.cshtml). Only used when UseMVC is true.

RichTextViewsPath.description: Folder holding the Rich Text Editor block component partial views ({alias}.cshtml). Only used when UseMVC is true.

DisableLinks.description: Neutralise href attributes on anchors in MVC-rendered previews so they cannot navigate the backoffice away.

Stylesheets.description: Stylesheets relative to wwwroot (e.g. "/css/site.css") served through /api/v1/Kraftvaerk.Umbraco.Headless.Blockpreview/css with :root variables inlined and html/body selectors rewritten to .__block-preview.

Selector.description: CSS selector (#id, .class or body) used to extract part of the returned HTML.

Template.description: HTML template for rendering the block preview. Use {{html}} as a placeholder.

EnableOutputCaching.description: Caches the preview based on the received JSON for up to 24 hours. Can be RAM expensive.

MaxConcurrentPreviews.description: How many preview requests a backoffice tab keeps in flight at once. Remaining blocks wait in a queue.

Debug.description: Logs every request and response as warnings. Failures are always logged, regardless of this setting.
